agenda_items.title: Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments – Garden and Garage Suites Secondary Suites [MPC2026-0402]
agenda_items.content: Mayor Block introduced the matter and a motion to consider first reading of Bylaw No. 10179 was passed. Paula Kotasek-Toth, Senior Project Planner, Community Services Division, reviewed the Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments – Garden and Garage Suites Secondary Suites with a PowerPoint and expressed the Division's support. Kreg Harley, Chair, Municipal Planning Commission, expressed the Commission's support of Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments – Garden and Garage Suites Secondary Suites (item 5.1.6) and Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments – Development on Corner Lots in the Transit Development Area (item 5.1.7). Council heard from the following speakers on this matter: Nicole Burgess, CEO, Saskatoon & Region Home Builders' Association, Inc., expressed support towards infill opportunities and responded to questions of the Council regarding future infill-related barriers the City could anticipate. Sherry Tarasoff, via teleconference, presented a video expressing opposition and raised concerns regarding accessibility and homeowner rights. Senior Project Planner Kotasek-Toth responded to questions of Council regarding massing requirements, sidewall regulations, infill development comparison between municipalities within the province of Saskatchewan, privacy requirements, utility capacity and limitations, along with Senior Project Planner Christine Gutmann and Director of Planning and Development Leslie Anderson.
agenda_items.recommendation: That City Council consider Bylaw No. 10179.
agenda_items.vote_detail: In Favour: (9) Councillor Jeffries, Councillor Donauer, Mayor Block, Councillor Dubois, Councillor Ford, Councillor MacDonald, Councillor Parker, Councillor Pearce, and Councillor Timon Absent: (2) Councillor Davies, and Councillor Kelleher CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY (9 to 0)

agenda_items.title: Proposed Official Community Plan Amendment – 702 and 706 Victoria Avenue [MPC2026-0403]
agenda_items.content: Mayor Block introduced the matter and a motion to consider first reading of Bylaw No. 10177 was passed. Brent McAdam, City Centre Planner, Community Services Division, reviewed the proposed Official Community Plan Amendment of 712 and 706 Victoria Avenue with a PowerPoint and expressed the Division's support. Kreg Harley, Chair, Municipal Planning Commission, expressed the Commission's support of 712 and 706 Victoria Avenue's proposed Official Community Plan Amendment (item 5.1.4) and proposed Rezoning by Agreement (item 5.1.5). James Peirce, Kindrachuk Agrey Architecture, addressed the matter using a PowerPoint presentation on building height limits, massing, and the shadow study’s impact on the neighbouring Marr Residence. City Centre Planner McAdam responded to questions of Council regarding short term rental regulations and dwelling unit ownership.
agenda_items.recommendation: That City Council consider Bylaw No. 10177.
agenda_items.vote_detail: In Favour: (9) Councillor Jeffries, Councillor Donauer, Mayor Block, Councillor Dubois, Councillor Kelleher, Councillor Ford, Councillor Parker, Councillor Pearce, and Councillor Timon Absent: (2) Councillor Davies, and Councillor MacDonald CARRIED UNANIMOUSLY (9 to 0)

Paula Kotasek-Toth, Senior Project Planner, Community Services Division, reviewed the Zoning Bylaw Text Amendments – Development on Corner Lots in the Transit Development Area with a PowerPoint and expressed the Division's support. She responded to questions of Council regarding formal parking regulations requiring number of spaces on-site, specific with use.
